description: share-v1 frames (fed-wire §3.7, §5.1). frame_hex is one whole fed-frame (u32 header_len, header, u32 body_len, body); a declaration_only row stops after body_len, because the receiver must refuse it before buffering any body byte. Decode each with the receiver's negotiated max_body_bytes. expect "valid" rows must decode to decoded; expect "violation" rows must close the share session with bye fed_protocol_violation (violation is the decoder's own label, informative only). on_ordinary_session is what an ordinary session must answer when it receives that frame.
